item.title: Chance The Rapper Is Celebrating 10th Anniversary of ‘Coloring Book’ With a Tour: Here Are the Dates
item.description:
[Energetic music plays]
Host: "What's up, music lovers? Welcome back to our show. We've got some exciting news to share with you today. Chance the Rapper is hitting the road to celebrate the 10th anniversary of his iconic mixtape, Coloring Book. And we're not just talking about a few select cities - this tour is massive, with stops in over 30 cities across North America."
[Music transitions to a clip from Coloring Book]
Host: "For those who may not know, Coloring Book was a game-changer when it dropped in 2016. It debuted at number 8 on the Billboard 200 chart and won the Grammy for Best Rap Album in 2017, making Chance the first independent artist to take home the award. The mixtape featured collaborations with some heavy-hitters, including Kanye West, Justin Bieber, and Lil Wayne."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "The Coloring Book 10 Tour kicks off in Cleveland on August 11th and wraps up in Pittsburgh on October 11th. And the best part? Tickets go on sale soon. Artist pre-sale tickets will be available on May 19th, with general public tickets going on sale on May 21st. Plus, there are some awesome VIP packages available that include meet-and-greet options with Chance himself."
[Music transitions to a clip from Chance's latest album, Star Line]
Host: "And if you're wondering what Chance has been up to lately, he released a new album called Star Line just last year, which peaked at number 22 on the Billboard 200 chart. But it's clear that Coloring Book still holds a special place in his heart, and we can't wait to see him bring it to life on stage."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "So, who's ready to celebrate 10 years of Coloring Book with Chance the Rapper? Check out the tour dates and get your tickets soon. We'll have all the details on our website. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
[Music fades out]
